notes: Flat 3% rate for tax periods beginning on or after Jan 1, 2025 (La. R.S. 47:32 as amended by Acts 2024, 3rd Ex. Sess., No. 11); graduated brackets repealed.

Standard deduction is CPI-indexed from 2026 (R.S. 47:294(B)); $12,875 single / $25,750 joint, HoH and qualifying surviving spouse are the 2026 amounts published by LDR on Form IT-540ESi (2026). LDR's earlier withholding rule cautioned final 2026 return amounts could differ slightly once January 2026 CPI-U data was applied.
The former combined personal exemption-standard deduction was replaced by the standard deduction; there is no separate personal exemption for 2025+.
Not modeled: Louisiana subtractions/exempt income (e.g., retirement income exemption for age 65+, net capital gains deduction for qualifying sales), and nonrefundable/refundable credits.

seDeduction.note: Louisiana starts from federal AGI, so the deductible half of SE tax (an above-the-line federal adjustment) is already excluded.

seHealthInsurance.note: The self-employed health insurance deduction is an above-the-line federal adjustment inherited through federal AGI.

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) deductions are above-the-line federal adjustments inherited through federal AGI.

qbi.note: The federal QBI deduction is taken after AGI, so it does not reduce the state base.

localIncomeTax.note: Louisiana parishes and municipalities do not levy a local individual income tax.

estimatedTax.threshold: Estimated Louisiana income tax after credits and withholding reasonably expected to exceed $1,000 (single) or $2,000 (joint filers) (La. R.S. 47:116)
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: No underpayment penalty if timely payments equal the lesser of 90% of the current-year Louisiana tax liability or 100% of the prior-year liability (prior year must be a full 12-month year with a liability). Underpayment penalty is 12% per year under R.S. 47:118 (Form R-210R).
estimatedTax.form: IT-540ES (voucher) / IT-540ESi instructions; payments also via LaTAP

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $125 Articles of Organization (Louisiana LLC), effective Oct 1, 2026 under Act 921 of 2026 (previously $100)
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $35 annual report, filed every year (effective Oct 1, 2026; previously $30)
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None. The corporation franchise tax is repealed for periods beginning on or after Jan 1, 2026 (Act 6, 2024 3rd Ex. Sess.); it never applied to LLCs taxed as disregarded entities or partnerships.
